# MRMhub Workflow Examples

::: {.lead}
Reproducible example reports of the MRMhub targeted LC-MS data-processing pipeline
:::

::: {.title-sep}
:::

These notebooks reproduce the [**MRMhub**](https://slinghub.github.io/MRMhub) pipeline end-to-end on real targeted LC-MS datasets — from INTEGRATOR peak-integration results through QUANT normalization, quantification, quality control and reporting. Each is a self-contained Quarto notebook combining narrative, executable R and outputs, provided as Supplementary Materials for the MRMhub manuscript.

## Workflows

::: {.arrow-list}
- **[Dataset 1 ↗](Dataset1.html)** — *SPERFECT* study: serial plasma lipidomics in participants at risk of coronary artery disease, Tan *et al.* [@tan2022]; 482 features (464 transitions), 937 samples. ISTD normalization, quantification, drift/batch correction and QC filtering.
- **[Dataset 3 ↗](Dataset3.html)** — *DYNAMO* study: plasma lipid biomarkers of renal function decline in type 2 diabetes, Chen *et al.* [@chen2025]; 828 features (748 transitions), 4,591 samples. The same pipeline at population scale.
- **[Dataset 4 ↗](Dataset4.html)** — *Steroid panel*: fully quantitative serum steroid assay (Gradient 1, 15 analytes) [@jansen2014]. MRMhub-QUANT postprocessing: ISTD normalization, external calibration, quantification and QC bias/variability against reference targets, with CSV/XLSX/RDS export.
:::

**Related:**

::: {.arrow-list}
- **[Dataset 4 · MRMhub vs MassHunter ↗](Dataset4_Comparison.html)** — validates MRMhub against Agilent MassHunter across the INTEGRATOR (peak areas) and QUANT (concentrations) modules for the steroid panel.
- **[Manuscript figure ↗](ManuscriptFigure.html)** — worked example of assembling publication-ready QC panels with MRMhub, reproducing the manuscript workflow figure's data panels from the Dataset 1 (SPERFECT) pipeline.
:::
